propositions: Add asserted_capability_confirmed as an na-default graded VALIDITY sub-answer to the shared GRADED_BINARY so the verifier can confirm or refute a capability-gap finding on evidence.

The sub-answer uses yes=finding-holds polarity: yes confirms the gap (validity retained), no means the capability was delivered (validity drops, dropping the false non-delivery finding), na abstains outside the G6/E4/T3 cohort.
Both plan-review and code-review Binary models inherit the field via the shared _build_binary and default it to na.
The change is scoped to the validity axis only, with no cross-field coupling to divergent_implementation, deliberately not replicating the research-doc impact-promotion direction.
IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION is deliberately not bumped because the field touches neither impact_code nor impact_plan shape and byte-identical replay requires sidecars stay un-segmented.
Code-review behaviour must be pinned byte-identical whether the field is absent or na, gated behind E5 replay and E6 self-consistency (κ=0.874).
